what_it_does: Reduces memory requirements for graph neural networks using hyperdimensional computing, which encodes information as extremely long binary vectors. CiliaGraph enables this by using much shorter hypervectors (hundreds of bits instead of tens of thousands) while maintaining accuracy through error-tolerant neural principles. The approach rebuilds core hyperdimensional computing operations to overcome three incompatibilities with graph neural networks: preventing feature distortion through better encoding, handling structural bias with weighted aggregation, and filling coverage gaps through expanded supervision.
